E1.question: Which measured facts help fix a feasible coupled design?
E1.accept_task: initial delivery=0/4, all5 witness checks PASS, witness in declared domain; same physical task under all levels
E1.falsifier: Richer feedback does not improve matched performance, or F0 adaptive probing matches it.
E1.analysis_unit: paired physical task, not model call or candidate evaluation

E2.question: Will an agent pay for a useful measurement before choosing a direction?
E2.cost_units: one complete transient evaluation=1, diagnose=0.2; monetary and token costs reported separately
E2.qualification: identical public specification and F0; full single-axis physical-domain scan, boundary refinement, and independently tighter repeats; pairwise numerical feasible bands do not overlap; both own witnesses PASS and crossed witnesses FAIL
E2.current_scope: controlled single-axis C or attached-mass repair; other fields publicly fixed; this is not a full fourteen-variable nonoverlap theorem
E2.falsifier: A common feasible point exists, another free variable bypasses the ambiguity, or paid diagnosis brings no net benefit.

E3.question: When does a structural change help, and when does a steady proxy mislead?
E3.structural_qualification: Local controls: single-beam full PASS and any auxiliary-beam geometry excluded by public area constraint. Required-branch tasks: independent mixed-domain global counterexample searches across every declared no-A branch plus per-task targeted checks, no full-service hit; A-on full PASS witnesses. This is the numerical factory-check rule, separate from E4 analytic exclusion bounds.
E3.proxy_qualification: numerically optimized open-circuit point full FAIL, a distinct same-domain point full PASS
E3.area_status: 300mm2 projected mechanical beam area is applied to new explicitly dimensioned stock; original 408mm2 reference is not silently relabeled
E3.falsifier: Proxy optimum itself passes, or current branch has a passing same-domain alternative.
E3.difficulty_index: The proposed chi had no defining equation. Actual stress utilization and energy burden are recorded as distinct physical measurements; acceptance uses full service, area, and counterexample search rather than inventing a shared chi label.
E3.proxy_area_scope: The sixteen proxy-mismatch tasks retain their original baseline geometry and length-only domain; the300mm2 bound applies to the sixteen structural tasks.

E4.question: Which facts permit a justified stop instead of a global claim from failed points?
E4.S1: 16 current-branch witnesses with real PASS/FAIL-bracketed local windows; 0.0625mm boundary resolution
E4.S2: 16 thin-film platform tasks: safe direct-branch voltage bound below original minimum start1.9V; original C80–1000uF range; alternate boost witnesses PASS
E4.S3: 16 small-width platform tasks: all-branch first-deadline energy bound below original minimum startup energy; original C80–1000uF/start1.9–3.2V; real3/4 histories with other service checks PASS
E4.bound: S2 uses passive piezo charge/stress voltage upper bound; S3 uses integral acceleration and damping energy upper bound before first deadline; both cover each task explicit manufactured platform and legal domain
E4.falsifier: Bound not global over declared domain, bound too loose, or branch switch not covered.

decision_labels.FEASIBLE: submitted design actually passes all service and safety checks
decision_labels.INFEASIBLE_CURRENT: valid exclusion of only the current declared branch; not a global stop
decision_labels.INFEASIBLE_ALL: valid exclusion covering every declared branch
decision_labels.UNSURE: no passing witness or covering exclusion established

performance_percentages: No preregistered positive outcome. All proposed pass-rate targets remain hypotheses.
report_inputs: cases: [{name, design, task, provenance, evolution:[...]}] ; calibration engineering examples until formal Agent trajectories exist.

A.agent: same model and same loop as L

Pi.model_provider_and_cost_cap: explicit CLI arguments; native SDK usage, between-response estimated-cost stop

comparison_rules.total_wall_and_model_budget: set before any future Agent run; none starts during task calibration
comparison_rules.public_assets: public task and selected feedback condition only; private qualification witnesses and truth labels are not model inputs

task_acceptance_is_not_agent_performance: Task construction must meet its physical entry conditions. Future Agent pass rates, diagnosis choices, and stopping accuracy are measured outcomes, never task-selection rules.

public_module_defaults.scope: Same explicit module configuration for every condition; only supplies missing optional-module values when that branch is enabled; calibrated data and initial designs unchanged.
